channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Fire onboard ship at Chinese shipyard kills 25 people
item.description: At least 25 people were killed after a fire broke out aboard a ship at a shipyard in China.

item.title: More than a dozen children killed in fire in eastern DR Congo schools
item.description: Authorities say at least 14 school children have been killed after fire ravaged schools in the DR Congo.

item.title: Family of four killed as they slept in Israeli strike on Gaza
item.description: Four members of a Palestinian family, including girls aged 8 and 12, were killed in an Israeli air attack as they slept

item.title: Trump’s Iran war now has a midterm election problem
item.description: Trump has tied the end of his war on Iran to the midterms. But with Iran holding firm, the political cost is mounting.

item.title: Jerusalem Daily: Israeli strikes devastate Gaza
item.description: Israeli air strikes have killed and injured dozens across Gaza.

item.title: Oil jumps to $105, pushing up chances of a US interest rate increase
item.description: Prices spiked as attacks on oil tankers escalated amid the US-Iran war.

item.title: At least 20 killed in school fire in rebel-held DR Congo city
item.description: Victims from the fire in AFC/M23-held Bukavu include primary school students, say officials and media reports.

item.title: Houthis capture Yemeni town of Mocha: Why it’s important
item.description: The Houthi seizure of Mocha threatens global trade routes, severs vital supply lines, and displaces thousands in Yemen.

item.title: Yemen’s Houthis seize strategic Red Sea city of Mocha
item.description: Houthis deliver 'significant blow' to the Yemeni government, expand control over Bab al-Mandeb, analysts say.

item.title: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
item.description: Mokha's capture would bring the Iran-backed group closer to controlling the Bab al-Mandab Strait waterway, a key shipping route.
